subject: general
question: Which region of India is usually affected by tropical cyclones?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Coastal region.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tropical cyclones, also known as typhoons or hurricanes, are among the most destructive weather phenomena. **
 
• They are intense circular storms that originate over warm tropical oceans and have maximum sustained wind speeds exceeding 119 kilometers per hour and heavy rains.
 
• Classifications of **Tropical cyclones are Tropical Depression, Tropical Storm, Typhoon, and Super Typhoon.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tropical cyclones** occur in the months of** May-June and October-November in India. **
 
• On average around 2 to 4 tropical cyclones impact India every year.
 
• While most of these tropical cyclones impact the east coast of Indian states of** West Bengal, Odisha, Andhra Pradesh, and Tamil Nadu.**
 
• **In general, the coastal districts of West Bengal, Orissa, Andhra Pradesh, and Tamil Nadu are more prone and are in the high to very high category of risk due to cyclones.**
